Support
Frequently asked questions
What documents do I need to rent a car? +
You need a valid Malaysian driving licence (or international driving permit for tourists), a valid IC or passport, and for student rates, a valid student ID from a recognised university.
What is the minimum rental period? +
Minimum rental is 2 hours for hourly bookings, or 1 day for daily bookings. Special and overnight rates apply for off-peak hours.
Can I pick up from the airport? +
Yes! We offer airport pickup at Kota Kinabalu International Airport (KKIA) and Labuan Airport. Please book at least 24 hours in advance for airport pickups.
Is insurance included? +
Yes, all our vehicles come with comprehensive insurance coverage. Renters are responsible for any traffic summons or fines incurred during the rental period.
What payment methods are accepted? +
We accept FPX online banking (all major Malaysian banks), DuitNow QR, and cash. A refundable security deposit is required upon pickup.

Our Story

Driven by passion,
built for everyone

Carvalry was founded with a simple vision: to make reliable, affordable car rental accessible to every student, adult, and tourist across Sabah and Labuan.

How Carvalry began

Carvalry started as a student-driven initiative in Labuan, born out of frustration with the lack of affordable and reliable transportation options for university students and visitors in the region.

What started as a small fleet of 3 vehicles quickly expanded as word spread about our transparent pricing and excellent service. Today, Carvalry proudly operates across Sabah and Labuan with a growing fleet of 15 vehicles.

We believe that everyone deserves access to quality transportation without hidden fees or complicated processes.

Vision, Mission & Objectives

The principles that drive every decision we make at Carvalry

Vision

To be the most trusted and accessible car rental service in East Malaysia, empowering students, adults, and tourists to explore freely and affordably.

Mission

To provide well-maintained, affordable vehicles with transparent pricing and exceptional customer service across Sabah and Labuan, making every journey smooth and memorable.

Objectives

  • Provide affordable student-friendly rental rates with valid ID
  • Expand fleet to 100+ vehicles by 2032
  • Cover all major towns in Sabah and Labuan
  • Achieve seamless digital booking experience
  • Maintain 4.8+ customer satisfaction rating

📋 Terms & Conditions ▼ Read before proceeding
1. Driver Requirements
  • Renter must hold a valid Malaysian driving licence (P or full) or an International Driving Permit (IDP) for foreign nationals.
  • Minimum age of 18 years for P-licence holders and 21 years for adult/tourist renters.
  • Student renters must present a valid university student ID at vehicle pickup.
  • Licence must remain valid for the entire rental period.
2. Hire & Drive Permit
  • Carvalry vehicles operate under a Hire & Drive Permit as required under the Road Transport Act 1987.
  • The permit is valid for the registered driver only. Unauthorised drivers are strictly prohibited.
  • Vehicle travel is restricted to Sabah and Labuan only. Cross-state travel to Peninsular Malaysia or Sarawak requires prior written approval.
  • Renter must carry the rental agreement and permit copy inside the vehicle at all times.
3. Insurance Coverage
  • All vehicles carry third-party insurance and comprehensive cover with a renter excess of RM500 per claim.
  • Insurance does not cover: personal belongings, damage from DUI, off-road use, or unauthorised driver incidents.
  • Renter is fully liable for windscreen, tyre, and underbody damage not covered by insurance.
  • All accidents must be reported to Carvalry and the police within 24 hours.
4. Medical & Health Fitness
  • Renter declares they are medically fit to drive and free from any condition that impairs safe vehicle operation.
  • Driving under the influence of alcohol, drugs, or impairing medication is strictly prohibited.
  • Carvalry reserves the right to refuse rental to any person appearing unfit to drive at pickup.
5. Renter Responsibilities
  • Renter is responsible for all traffic summons, tolls, and parking fines during the rental period.
  • Vehicle must be returned with the same fuel level. Shortfall will be charged at RM0.50/km.
  • No smoking inside the vehicle. Cleaning fee of RM50-RM200 may apply for violations.
  • Late returns will be charged at the applicable hourly rate.
  • Vehicle must not be used for illegal activities, racing, or ride-hailing services.
6. Deposit & Payment
  • A refundable security deposit of RM200 is required at pickup, returned within 3 working days upon clean return.
  • Carvalry may withhold deposit to cover outstanding charges, damages, or fines.
7. Cancellation Policy
  • 24+ hours before pickup: Full refund.
  • 6-24 hours before pickup: 50% refund.
  • Less than 6 hours: No refund.
8. Governing Law
  • This agreement is governed by the laws of Malaysia, including the Road Transport Act 1987.
  • Disputes shall be resolved under the jurisdiction of Malaysian courts.

📋 Terms & Conditions

Carvalry Car Rental — Effective from 2025 — Sabah & Labuan, Malaysia

📋 1. Driver Requirements
  • Renter must hold a valid Malaysian driving licence (P or full) or an International Driving Permit (IDP) for foreign nationals.
  • Minimum age of 18 years old for P-licence holders and 21 years old for adult and tourist renters.
  • Licence must remain valid throughout the entire rental period.
  • Student renters must present a valid university or college student ID at vehicle pickup. Failure to do so will result in the student rate being forfeited.
  • Only the registered driver named in the booking is permitted to operate the vehicle.
📄 2. Hire & Drive Permit
  • All Carvalry vehicles are registered and operated under a valid Hire & Drive Permit as required under the Road Transport Act 1987 (Malaysia).
  • The permit authorises use of the vehicle by the registered driver only. Allowing unauthorised persons to drive is a serious offence and will void all insurance coverage.
  • Vehicle travel is restricted to the territories of Sabah and Labuan Federal Territory. Travel to Peninsular Malaysia or Sarawak requires prior written approval from Carvalry.
  • Renter must carry a printed or digital copy of the rental agreement and permit inside the vehicle at all times during the rental period.
  • Any breach of permit conditions renders the renter fully liable for all resulting consequences, including fines and legal penalties.
🛡️ 3. Insurance Coverage
  • All Carvalry vehicles carry third-party liability insurance as mandated by Malaysian law.
  • Comprehensive own-damage insurance applies subject to an excess/deductible of RM500 per claim, payable by the renter.
  • Insurance does not cover: personal belongings left in the vehicle, damage resulting from driving under the influence of alcohol or drugs, off-road or unsuitable terrain usage, damage caused by an unauthorised or unlicensed driver, or intentional damage.
  • Renter is fully liable for windscreen damage, tyre punctures or blowouts, underbody damage, and loss of vehicle keys.
  • In the event of any accident, collision, or vehicle damage, the renter must immediately notify Carvalry and file a police report within 24 hours. Failure to do so may invalidate insurance claims.
  • Carvalry reserves the right to recover uninsured losses directly from the renter.
❤️ 4. Medical & Health Fitness
  • By completing a booking, the renter declares and warrants that they are medically fit to operate a motor vehicle safely.
  • Renters must not drive while under the influence of alcohol, illegal drugs, or any prescription or over-the-counter medication that impairs driving ability.
  • Carvalry reserves the right to refuse vehicle handover to any person who appears to be unfit, intoxicated, or impaired at the time of pickup, without refund liability.
  • Renters with known medical conditions affecting driving should consult a medical professional before renting.
⚠️ 5. Renter Responsibilities
  • The renter is solely responsible for all traffic summons, toll charges, parking fines, and compound notices incurred during the rental period.
  • The vehicle must be returned with the same fuel level as at the time of pickup. Vehicles returned with less fuel will be charged at RM0.50 per kilometre travelled or RM30 minimum refuelling charge, whichever is higher.
  • Smoking inside the vehicle is strictly prohibited. A cleaning/deodorising fee of RM50 to RM200 will be imposed for violations.
  • The vehicle must be returned in a reasonably clean condition. Excessive soiling or interior damage will incur cleaning fees at Carvalry's discretion.
  • Late returns will be charged at the standard applicable hourly rate without prior notice. Renters should contact Carvalry in advance if an extension is required.
  • The vehicle must not be used for: illegal activities, street racing, ride-hailing or transport-for-hire services, towing other vehicles, or transporting hazardous materials.
💰 6. Deposit & Payment
  • A refundable security deposit of RM200 is required at the time of vehicle pickup and must be paid in cash or via approved digital transfer.
  • The deposit will be refunded within 3 working days following the return of the vehicle in satisfactory condition.
  • Carvalry reserves the right to withhold part or all of the deposit to offset any outstanding charges including but not limited to: unpaid fines, fuel shortfall, cleaning fees, repair costs, or loss of keys.
  • Full rental payment is required at the time of booking confirmation. Bookings are not confirmed until payment is received.
❌ 7. Cancellation & Refund Policy
  • More than 24 hours before scheduled pickup: Full refund of rental amount.
  • Between 6 and 24 hours before scheduled pickup: 50% refund of rental amount.
  • Less than 6 hours before scheduled pickup or no-show: No refund.
  • In the event that Carvalry must cancel a booking due to vehicle unavailability or unforeseen circumstances, a full refund will be issued within 5 working days.
  • Refunds will be returned via the original payment method.
📞 8. Breakdown & Emergency
  • In the event of a vehicle breakdown, renter must contact Carvalry immediately at +60 16-841 7376.
  • Carvalry will make reasonable efforts to provide a replacement vehicle or roadside assistance. Response time may vary depending on location.
  • Renters must not attempt to repair the vehicle themselves or engage unauthorised workshops without prior written consent from Carvalry.
  • Breakdown due to renter negligence (e.g. running out of fuel, tyre damage from off-road driving) will be charged to the renter.
📝 9. Privacy & Data
  • Personal data collected during the booking process is governed by the Personal Data Protection Act 2010 (PDPA) Malaysia.
  • Carvalry will not sell, share, or disclose your personal data to third parties except as required by law or for the purpose of fulfilling your rental booking.
  • By completing a booking, you consent to Carvalry retaining your booking records for a period of up to 3 years for administrative and legal purposes.
⚖️ 10. Governing Law & Disputes
  • This agreement and all disputes arising from it shall be governed exclusively by the laws of Malaysia, including the Road Transport Act 1987, the Hire-Purchase Act 1967, and the Contracts Act 1950.
  • Any unresolved disputes shall be submitted to the jurisdiction of Malaysian courts, with Sabah courts having primary jurisdiction.
  • Carvalry reserves the right to amend these Terms & Conditions at any time without prior notice. The latest version will always be available at our official website.
